title: Excavation
mission: The storage area 'sandbox/clutter' is full of junk. Locate 'sandbox/clutter/secret_*.txt' amidst the clutter, create the directory 'sandbox/secure_vault', and move the key into it. Run './verify_vault' to decrypt the vault and reveal the flag!
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search man pages for keywords like directories / make / remove
